citation.title: Evolutionary design of conductive pathways using a generative autoencoder
citation.authors: Matei C. Ignuta-Ciuncanu, Hannes Stärk, Ricardo F. Martinez-Botas
citation.venue: International Communications in Heat and Mass Transfer 166:109098

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: The abstract reports improved thermal-design metrics over standard methods: average device temperature is reduced by 10%, peak hotspot temperature by up to 1%, and Pareto-front hypervolume increases by 13%.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: The abstract gives no classical-versus-ML speed-up factor.

baseline.quality_gap: Abstract reports average temperature reduced by 10%, peak hotspot temperature reduced by up to 1%, and hypervolume increased by 13%.
